exposure: Mode of delivery (caesarean section vs vaginal birth)
outcome: Attendance for postpartum check with a general practitioner
cohort: 193 women who had immediate postpartum hormonal IUD insertion at a tertiary maternity service over three years
finding: Immediate postpartum hormonal IUD insertion was associated with higher expulsion rates and lower satisfaction rates compared to delayed postpartum insertion.
mod_finding: Expulsion was more likely after vaginal birth (34.1%) than caesarean section (10.1%).
